data.name: Niamh
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Irish word 'necht' meaning 'radiant, bright' and 'fionn' meaning 'fair, white', Niamh is the name of a goddess of the Irish mythology who was described as having radiant beauty. She was also known as the goddess of fertility and the protector of the dead.
